flags.why: 'Tún ni' is not the Huế expression for 'tonight'; the intended phrase is 'túi ni'.
flags.fix: Túi ni lên nôốc ngắm kiểng. = Tonight we'll get on the boat to look at the scenery. ([Huế dictionary](https://langhue.org/index.php/bien-khao/vien-tai-lieu-trau-cau/7284-tvhb-tu-dien-tieng-hue-ho-van-hien.html))
